label: Broadcast Lower Third
description: Broadcast-quality lower third for identifying a person on screen -- a speaker, customer, host, expert, or quoted source. Anchors to the bottom-left (bottom-right with side:'right') with safe margins, enters at `at` seconds, holds, and exits gracefully on scenes of 5s or longer. ONE component, EIGHT presets via data.style: 'clean-bar' (white card + thin accent rule, slide-in with overshoot -- the safe default), 'accent-underline' (transparent, big name, accent underline draws left-to-right), 'bold-block' (solid accent name block + offset dark title block, staggered slide), 'color-block' (stacked accent/near-black blocks wipe in via scaleX, text reveals after), 'dark-card' (dark glass card with blur + subtle border, rises with fade), 'kicker-name' (tiny uppercase accent kicker above a big rising name -- the title becomes the kicker line), 'mask-reveal' (name/title rise through a baseline clip mask while a thin rule expands), 'soft-pill' (rounded white pill, back.out pop). Place over interview, testimonial, speaker, or demo scenes at a HIGH z_index. Example: {"name":"Sarah Chen","title":"VP Marketing, Acme","style":"dark-card","at":0.6,"side":"left"}.

name.label: Person or entity name, e.g. "Sarah Chen"

vertical.label: Vertical anchor
vertical.description: bottom (the lower third proper) or top (a top third, for a scene whose bottom band is busy)

scale.label: Size multiplier: sets the card's size (1 = default, 1.5 = 50% larger). The lower third places itself in the frame, so its size is this, not its box.

margin.label: Margin from its box's edges, % (default 6 from the side, 8 from the bottom; 0 = flush to the edge). The margin keeps the card clear of rounded phone corners and platform buttons.
